description: Up to five color schemes for the link page built around one color, as a color wheel would: Complementary, Complementary dark, Analogous, Triadic and Shades of one color (near-duplicates dropped, so a gray gives fewer). With ground, all five harmonies (complementary, analogous, triadic, split, mono) on that ground. Every scheme reads with no design warnings and never uses a tan background. Nothing is saved: Apply one with bio_page_update { design: { colors } } (on a gradient background also set background.style "solid", or color2 to match).

ground.description: Put every scheme on a light or a dark background

name: bio_color_schemes
title: Color schemes for a color
